weak_videos.title: This Is How TATA Became India's Most Powerful Business Empire 🚀Description:
likely_reasons: Despite high like percentage (5.2%), the hook failed to reach a wide audience
Topic is saturated; needs a more unique angle

what_works: India-centric content (Cities, War, Maritime boundaries) consistently exceeds the 1234 median
Geopolitical comparisons (India vs China, Top 5 Powerful Countries)
Hinglish titles (Hindi text + English keywords) with high-impact emojis like 😱, 🇮🇳, and 🔥
Listicles (Top 5, Top 3) provide a clear structure that aids retention
Custom thumbnails: 90% of videos above the median views utilize a custom thumbnail

diagnosis.hook: Weak videos use 'Statement Titles' (e.g., Photosynthesis Explained) which fail to create a curiosity gap. Strong videos use 'Question/Challenge Hooks' (e.g., भारत किस नंबर पर है?).
diagnosis.buildup: Videos around 45-50 seconds are performing best, suggesting the audience prefers a detailed narrative over very short 30-second clips, provided the topic is high-stakes.
diagnosis.visuals: There is a direct correlation between the absence of custom thumbnails and sub-100 view counts. Visual metadata is being ignored on low-performing clips.
diagnosis.titles_topics: The channel audience is highly motivated by National Pride and Global Power Dynamics. Scientific or niche biological facts (Mantis Shrimp, Photosynthesis) do not resonate with the current subscriber base.
diagnosis.other: Publishing between 06:00 and 09:00 IST shows a cluster of high performers, while late afternoon/evening uploads have more variance.

hook_rules: Start with a 'Did you know' or 'The secret of' framing
Use a curiosity gap: Mention a result but not the cause in the first 3 seconds
Always include at least two relevant emojis in the title
For Hindi content, use Hindi script for the emotional part of the hook
Address the viewer directly using 'Aap' or 'You'
buildup_rules: Use the 'Rule of 3': Present three facts leading up to the biggest revelation
Maintain a fast cut every 2-3 seconds to prevent scrolling
Use progress bars or 'Step 1, Step 2' overlays
Keep the duration between 40-55 seconds for maximum 'information density'
visual_rules: Custom thumbnails are mandatory for every upload
Include a 'Shocked Face' or 'Comparison' image in the thumbnail
Ensure on-screen captions are large and centered to avoid UI overlap
title_rules: Mix Hindi and English (Hinglish) to capture both search and browse traffic
Keep titles under 60 characters to avoid truncation
Use 'Power Words' like Unbelievable, Mystery, Warning, or Powerful
Never leave 'Description:' or technical tags in the visible title
topic_rules: Focus 70% of content on Indian History, Geopolitics, and Achievements
Use 'Top 5' formats for general facts to increase 'completion rate' desire
avoid: Generic titles that sound like a textbook chapter
Niche topics that don't have a 'Why this matters to you' angle
Long intros; get straight to the fact in under 1.5 seconds
